source_refs.note: Half-Wave Rectifier: a main subheading of 17.14 Rectification, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 106-107.

blocks.text: Half-wave rectification mein AC signal ka ek aadha cycle guzarta hai aur doosra aadha rok diya jata hai; is tarah pulsating (jhatkon wala) DC milta hai. Fig. 17.13 mein period T ka alternating voltage (input voltage) ek diode D ko diya gaya hai jo load resistance R_L ke saath series mein hai. Diode current ko sirf ek direction mein jane deta hai, is liye AC signal DC signal ban jata hai. Fig. 17.13 circuit aur input/output waves dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: AC voltage input signal, 0, 90 aur 180 degree. Beech mein: transformer diode D (forward resistance rf) aur load resistor RL ko series mein deta hai; current I, load current Idc aur output voltage Vdc marked. Daen: DC voltage output signal; positive half cycle guzarte (conducting) aur negative half cycles mein output zero (cut off).
blocks.caption: Figure 17.13: Half-wave rectifier ka kaam, input aur output waves graph par (kitab ki Figure 17.13 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke output graph mein negative aadhe cycles bhi bane hue hain, halanke diode unhein rok deta hai. Sahi output un hisson mein zero hai; drawing mein yeh hisse sirf halki dashed lakeer se dikhaye gaye hain ke input kya tha.

Input ke positive aadhe cycle (waqt 0 se T/2) mein diode D forward bias hota hai: is ki resistance bohat kam hoti hai aur R_L mein current behta hai. Is current se R_L par voltage banta hai jo input ke saath upar neeche hota hai (Fig. 17.13).

blocks.title: For your information (aap ki maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Half-wave rectifier ka circuit board, jis par us ke alag alag parts (transformer, diode, capacitor waghera) lage hain.

blocks.alt: Half-wave rectifier ka trainer board: mains plug aur laal-neeli taar peele board tak jaati hai jis par HALF WAVE RECTIFIER likha hai; us par step-down transformer T1, diode 1N5402, 1000 µF capacitor, 1K resistor, LED, output sockets 12 V aur GND, aur POWER ON / OFF switch hai.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: half-wave rectifier ka circuit board aur us ke parts (kitab ke box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Block diagram: 220 V AC rectifier mein, phir battery, phir inverter aur aakhir mein AC appliance. Rectifier ke neeche battery charger us ka output le kar battery ko deta hai. Note: rectifiers are used in UPS at homes for backup power.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.13 (a): Hamare gharon mein use hone wale UPS ka circuit view (kitab ki Figure 17.13 (a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Negative aadhe cycle (waqt T/2 se T) mein diode reverse bias ho jata hai aur bohat zyada resistance deta hai, is liye R_L mein taqreeban koi current nahi aur us par voltage taqreeban zero hota hai. Agle cycles mein yahi repeat hota hai. R_L mein current sirf ek direction mein behta hai, yani DC hai, lekin pulses (jhatkon) mein. R_L par aane wale voltage ko output voltage kehte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bijli aane par rectifier AC ko DC banata hai aur charger battery charge karta hai. Bijli jane par battery ki DC inverter mein ja kar dobara AC ban jati hai aur appliance chalta rehta hai.
